ex.en: His red coat made him conspicuous in the grey crowd.
ex.zh: 他的红外套使他在灰暗的人群中格外显眼。

words.note: 反义 inconspicuous；多指显眼、易被注意。

ex.en: He wrote short verses about the countryside where he grew up.
ex.zh: 他写了一些关于自己成长乡村的短诗。

words.note: 不可数指诗体，可数指诗句；与 prose 相对。

ex.en: He has a criminal record and cannot enter the country.
ex.zh: 他有犯罪记录，不能入境。

words.note: 注意 criminal law 是刑法；名词指罪犯。

ex.en: She was furious with her brother for losing the keys.
ex.zh: 她因弟弟丢了钥匙而对他大发脾气。

words.note: be furious with sb about sth；名词 fury。

ex.en: Childhood obesity has become a serious public health problem.
ex.zh: 儿童肥胖已成为严重的公共健康问题。

words.note: 形容词 obese；正式医学用语，慎用 fat。

ex.en: She spent two weeks on the beach and came back with a tan.
ex.zh: 她在海滩待了两周，回来时晒黑了。

words.note: 作动词指晒黑或鞣革；get a tan 指晒黑。

ex.en: The course is designed to meet the needs of individual students.
ex.zh: 这门课程旨在满足个别学生的需求。

words.note: 作形容词指个别的、独特的；作名词指个人。

ex.en: He put the documents in his briefcase and left the office.
ex.zh: 他把文件放进公文包，然后离开了办公室。

words.note: 由 brief（摘要）+ case（箱）构成。

ex.en: The noise from the building site is a real nuisance.
ex.zh: 工地的噪音真是讨厌。

words.note: make a nuisance of oneself 指惹人厌。

ex.en: The residents braced themselves for the coming storm.
ex.zh: 居民们为即将到来的暴风雨做好了准备。

words.note: 常搭配 brace oneself for sth；也指支架、牙箍。

ex.en: Small budgets constrain what the school can offer students.
ex.zh: 预算有限限制了学校能为学生提供的条件。

words.note: 名词 constraint；be constrained by 表受限于。

ex.en: A brisk walk before breakfast helps me stay awake all morning.
ex.zh: 早饭前快步走能让我一上午都清醒。

words.note: 常形容步伐轻快或生意兴隆；副词 briskly。

ex.en: The university has gained international prestige in recent years.
ex.zh: 这所大学近年来获得了国际声望。

words.note: 不可数，指因成就而得的威望；形容词 prestigious。

ex.en: Good insulation can cut heating bills by half.
ex.zh: 良好的隔热能把取暖费减少一半。

words.note: 由 insulate 变来，指隔热、绝缘。

ex.en: The electric cord was too short to reach the wall socket.
ex.zh: 电源线太短，够不到墙上的插座。

words.note: 指细绳、电线；注意与 chord（和弦）同音。

ex.en: The sudden noise startled the birds and they flew away.
ex.zh: 突然的响声惊动了鸟，它们飞走了。

words.note: 指使人突然受惊；形容词 startled 指受惊的。

ex.en: The committee will publish an interim report before the final one.
ex.zh: 委员会将在最终报告之前发布一份中期报告。

words.note: in the interim 等于 meanwhile；也指过渡的。

ex.en: He was arrested for committing fraud against elderly customers.
ex.zh: 他因对老年客户实施诈骗而被捕。

words.note: 不可数指欺诈，可数指骗子；commit fraud。

ex.en: Her success is a testimony to the value of hard work.
ex.zh: 她的成功证明了努力工作的价值。

words.note: 法律语境指证词；a testimony to sth 表明证。

ex.en: The city council voted to build a new public library.
ex.zh: 市议会投票决定新建一座公共图书馆。

words.note: 注意与 counsel（建议、律师）区分。

ex.en: The two sides reaffirmed their commitment to the peace agreement.
ex.zh: 双方重申了对和平协议的承诺。

words.note: re-（再）+ affirm（断言），指再次确认立场。

ex.en: Police officers have a duty to enforce traffic laws.
ex.zh: 警察有责任执行交通法规。

words.note: 指强制执行法律或规定；enforcement 指执行。

ex.en: The Christmas tree glittered with hundreds of small lights.
ex.zh: 圣诞树上千百盏小灯闪闪发光。

words.note: 指闪光、闪耀；形容词 glittering 指闪亮的。

ex.en: He was destined to become one of the country's finest doctors.
ex.zh: 他注定会成为全国最优秀的医生之一。

words.note: be destined to do 或 be destined for sth。

ex.en: The report described years of political repression in the region.
ex.zh: 报告描述了该地区多年的政治压制。

words.note: 动词 repress；既指镇压，也指压抑情感。

ex.en: The peace agreement remains fragile after months of fighting.
ex.zh: 经过数月战斗，和平协议依然脆弱。

words.note: 指易碎或脆弱，可形容物品、健康、和平。

ex.en: Drivers who ignore the rule will pay a heavy penalty.
ex.zh: 无视这条规定的司机将付出沉重的代价。

words.note: 指处罚、罚金；pay the penalty for 付出代价。

ex.en: She studied sociology and later worked for a social research group.
ex.zh: 她学的是社会学，后来在一家社会研究机构工作。

words.note: socio-（社会）+ -logy（学科）；形容词 sociological。

ex.en: The writer spent ten years in exile before returning home.
ex.zh: 这位作家流亡十年后才回到家乡。

words.note: in exile 表流亡状态；be exiled from 指被流放。

ex.en: The project was carried out on a much larger scale than planned.
ex.zh: 这个项目的实施规模比计划大得多。

words.note: on a large scale 是常用短语；也指秤的刻度。
